newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil creeps higher with futures, prems stea.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil creeps higher with futures, prems stea.

text.p: NWE gas oil was nudged higher on Wednesday as futures gained $1 and premiums held steady in a talkative, but eventually quiet day.
May IPE gas oil closed $1.00 a tonne higher at $167.50 on technical and late fund buying.
Traders said there had been a lot of talk today, but that little of the discussion had translated into deals.
The colder than normal weather gave the market a slightly bearish tone, but was not dramatically affecting premiums.
Heating oil barges were pegged around May IPE +$1 fob AR for refinery material with a deal concluded at this number.
"Its a bit higher, but only by 25-50 cents," said one dealer.
Heating oil cargo premiums were steady to narrowly firmer around May IPE +$4-4.50 cif NWE for little-talked FOD while more actively discussed DIN was about 50 cents stronger.
Diesel attracted less interest than in previous weeks with cargoes pegged around May IPE +$12 cif NWE.
